cases.scope: Finite SC proposed retirement composition, not C refinement. OS handler may start before uninstall and acquire admission after closure; already leased handlers may finish. Root-only routing, joined external users and failed join retention are independent. One failure plus eventual successful retry is a progress premise, not an OS guarantee. Negative root policy characterizes selected user_intr bypass; other negatives are incomplete retirement proposals. Weak memory, arbitrary native signal delivery, unlimited retries and full lifecycle acceptance remain separate.
